items.title: Week 2 Announcements
items.text: Today, Friday, September 4: The dedicated CSCI 127 lab is open 11:30-4pm (shorter hours on Fridays). Need some help getting started? The lab is staffed with amazing peer instructors who will guide you through the first lab and homework. …

items.title: Semester start: lab hours and lecture slides
items.text: 1001E HN lab hours: Monday–Thursday 11:30 am–5:15 pm, Friday 11:30 am–4:00 pm, when classes meet. Lecture slides are posted on Brightspace on Tuesdays at 9 am.
